sourcePolicy.name: Manual exact-NORAD official-source review
sourcePolicy.identityRule: Index by canonical NORAD catalog ID, then require the current object name, international designator, and exact SATCAT type to match the reviewed record.
sourcePolicy.purposeRule: Use only purpose text supported by the cited authoritative mission source; never infer purpose from name, type, owner, group, or orbit.
sourcePolicy.imageRule: Bundle only an image reviewed as depicting the exact object, with explicit public-display and transformation rights.
sourcePolicy.takedownProcedure: Remove the manifest record and bundled asset, run npm run check:orbital-enrichment, and deploy the resulting exact source revision. Never substitute a generic object image.

purpose.description: NASA describes Hubble as a large space-based observatory used to observe the universe and expand understanding of the cosmos.
purpose.identityEvidence: The reviewed CelesTrak visual snapshot identifies NORAD 20580 as HST, international designator 1990-037B, type PAY. The NASA page explicitly identifies the Hubble Space Telescope and its observatory purpose.
